`/desk-activity` now shows Claude Code's experimental advisor: every consult, with its model, tokens and time.

- While `/advisor` is on, each consult is a `▞` span on the main time bar and a flow row like `✓ advisor Fable 5.1 · read 66.2k · wrote 262 · 6s`; a failed one reads `✗` with its error code
- The advice itself never reaches Claude Code (the API sends it encrypted), so the row says `advice not shown`
- It reads the session transcript only while `/advisor` is on and the activity pane is open, and only the bytes added since the last read. With the advisor off or the pane closed it does nothing. Measured with the pane open, turns cost the same as 0.67.2
- A consult appears once the step it was in has finished, since that is when Claude Code writes it to the transcript
- A turn where Claude consults the advisor but runs no tool doesn't open a new activity record, so that consult isn't shown

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
